name: zeffect_tick_reset_delay_on_timer
description: zEffect::TickResetDelayOnTimer decrements an animation entry countdown for timer activation modes and triggers a zero transform activation when the countdown reaches zero.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x458b50 has an x87 fstp flag-lift limitation. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffectAnim source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458b50 validates accepting activationMode 1 or 2, subtracting the timer delta from activationCountdown, comparing the new value with zero, calling zEffectAnim::SetTransformRotAndVelocity with zero transform arguments on non-positive countdown, and returning the stored countdown.
The native smoke verifies countdown subtraction, skipped mode behavior, and the non-positive countdown path with activation intentionally inert.
